title: Unit 33 Consolidation: Reading Literature
goal: I can use the words for reading a poem, its voices, a writer's duty and the unity of European literature.
I can describe a reading with a *-va/-ve* participle, a participle before the noun, a duty and *ahogyan … úgy*.
I can write one sentence about European literature with *ahogyan … úgy*.
